description:
A Super Top-up is an extension you can buy on your existing (or new) base health insurance cover. This policy can be from the same insurance company where your base plan is bought or any other. 
But you should be very careful while buying the Super Top-up, as it could impact your claim drastically. 

Watch the complete video for more details :)
